description: Unit tests for StaticRangeMap in the breakpad project, including test cases for range storage and retrieval, index-based retrieval, and serialization.

classes.name: TestStaticRangeMap
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing StaticRangeMap functionalities, including storing, retrieving, index retrieval, and serialization tests.

methods.name: StoreTest
methods.description: Tests storing a range in the RangeMap and verifies the outcome against expected storable result.

methods.name: RetrieveTest
methods.description: Tests retrieving a range from the RangeMap at various offsets and verifies correctness of retrieved data and nearest range.

methods.name: RetrieveIndexTest
methods.description: Verifies that RetrieveRangeAtIndex returns ranges in increasing address order and handles boundary conditions.

methods.name: RunTestCase
methods.description: Runs a sequence of store and retrieve tests for a specific test case index.
